name: PhD Program in the Biomedical Sciences
summary: Umbrella PhD at Albert Einstein College of Medicine in the Bronx. First-year students are accepted into the Graduate Division without committing to a department or training program.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The admissions page states "The Einstein PhD application deadline is December 1, 2026". No time of day is given.

timeline.interviews: Competitive applicants are invited to a virtual interview with faculty and current graduate students. Virtual interviews take place late January to early March.

english.note: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit an official TOEFL or IELTS score through BioMedCAS (TOEFL code B765), unless they completed a bachelor's, master's or equivalent degree at an institution where English is the only language of instruction. No minimum score is stated.

applicationFee.note: The admissions page does not mention fee waivers.

documents: Official transcripts from each college or university attended, submitted through BioMedCAS
Original transcript plus certified English translation if not in English
requirements.note: Recommendation letters must be submitted online and should come from people with direct knowledge of your academic and scientific qualifications. The admissions page does not mention the GRE.

funding.note: All PhD and MD/PhD students receive an annual stipend and full tuition remission for all years of training; the stipend is $51,500 per year (the page gives no year). Health insurance is provided at no cost. The page does not say whether international students are covered.

international.note: Applicants with non-English transcripts upload the original and a certified English translation.
